claims.text: Pulumi's latest stable release is v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table, and v3.263.0 (2026-09-16) in the license table and Pulumi section; these are inconsistent with each other.
Terraform's latest stable release is v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table and v1.16.3 (2026-09-16) elsewhere.
AWS CDK's latest stable release is v2.268.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table and v2.270.0 (2026-09-17) elsewhere.
Azure Bicep's latest stable release is v0.47.16 (2026-09-08), whereas the at-a-glance table (line 139) still lists v0.46.1.
Kubernetes latest stable release is v1.37.0 (2026-08-26).
Crossplane's latest stable release is v2.4.1 (2026-09-15), whereas the at-a-glance table (line 142) lists v2.4.0.
OpenTofu's latest version is v1.12.6 released 2026-08-19.
Version and release-date figures were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.

Kubernetes has roughly 127,900 GitHub stars; Terraform ~49,700, OpenTofu ~30,200, Pulumi ~25,700, AWS CDK ~12,900, Crossplane ~12,100, measured 2026-09-21; Terraform is the most-starred dedicated IaC tool.
env0 is now named env zero.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
Env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
